Carla downloads a 200 GB file at a constant speed of 2 GB/minute.  
Normal download time: 200 / 2 = 100 minutes.

First attempt: She reaches 40% of the file (0.40 × 200 = 80 GB) before the interruption.  
Time to download 80 GB: 80 / 2 = 40 minutes.

Then Windows forces a restart that takes 20 minutes, during which no downloading occurs.

After the restart, she must start the entire download from the beginning.  
Second attempt: She downloads the full 200 GB without further interruption, taking 100 minutes.

Total time = 40 minutes (first partial download) + 20 minutes (restart) + 100 minutes (full download) = 160 minutes.

Answer: 160 minutes
